summary: Package definition for the shared API validation package, which exposes its entry file and depends on the zod library.
purpose: Lets other parts of the workspace import the API validation code under the name @workspace/api-zod.
why: Likely reason: it is a shared package in a monorepo, so several apps can reuse the same definitions.
how: The package is marked private so it is never published. Its entry point is the src/index.ts file. It declares zod as its only dependency, with the version taken from the workspace catalog.
inputs: The package manager installs zod. Other packages import from this name.
risks: The entry file points at generated code that is not in this package listing. If that code has not been generated, imports will fail.
debug: Check that the src/generated folder exists. Run the workspace install command again. Confirm that other packages list @workspace/api-zod as a dependency.
